derivation.behavior: Schedules are timezone-aware and define missed-run behavior.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go evaluates recurring windows and missed-run policy with injected clock/timezone.

invariants: Timezone resolution is injected for deterministic tests.
Overnight windows are evaluated against local civil time.
DST forward/back transitions use the local clock after timezone conversion.
A missed window can be started only according to the persisted missed-run policy and grace window.
